These two JSON bodies are copied without modification from the supervisor's
`vectors/config-settings-v1` directory in `cortexkit/subconscious`. The matching
rows of the upstream `SHA256SUMS` are included here. They exercise the schema dialect,
its normalized digest, and the default effective values and source pointers.
The corpus contains operator-facing settings calls, not the module's delivery
requests and replies; those are exercised separately on the module connection.
